summary.zh: 把两个表面变成相邻位置，重新组织路线。
summary.en: Make distant surfaces adjacent and rewire a route.

rules.zh: 玩家在允许的表面放置一对互通入口，让角色或物体从一个入口穿出另一个。入口位置、朝向与进出速度共同决定结果，玩家通过更换入口反复检验空间方案。
rules.en: Place paired openings on allowed surfaces so objects entering one emerge from the other. Position, orientation and motion determine the result; replace portals to test spatial plans.

loop.en: Send a character or object through

decisions.zh: 入口靠近目标，还是先获得足够的进入速度？
decisions.en: Place an entrance near the goal or build entry speed first?

decisions.zh: 替换入口会不会切断仍需使用的通路？
decisions.en: Will replacing a portal destroy a route still needed?

effect.zh: 限制表面强化解题方向；大量表面增加搜索空间。
effect.en: Restricted surfaces focus solutions; many surfaces widen the search.

effect.zh: 单对入口降低记忆负担；多对支持协作网络。
effect.en: One pair limits memory load; multiple pairs support collaboration.

implementation.zh: 一对传送门连接可用表面，玩家通过空间和动量关系越过测试室障碍。
implementation.en: One portal pair links surfaces so spatial and momentum relationships bypass chamber obstacles.

observation.zh: 观察墙上的传送门与地面方块，思考物体进入后会从哪里出来；静态图不显示动量过程。
observation.en: Observe the wall portal and floor cube, then consider the exit position; momentum is not demonstrated by the still.

implementation.zh: 合作模式让两位玩家各管理一对入口，形成需要协调的多段路线。
implementation.en: Co-op gives each player a portal pair, creating coordinated multi-stage routes.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：可见传送门与穿过空间的设施；不是激光反射解法或合作过程的证明。
observation.en: System reference: portals and chamber infrastructure are visible; this does not establish a laser solution or co-op sequence.

contrast.zh: 第一作集中训练单人理解；第二作的合作模式把替换入口变成沟通问题。
contrast.en: The first trains individual understanding; the sequel’s co-op makes portal replacement a communication problem.

combination.zh: 组合提案：物流传送门只能维持一条连接，玩家安排不同材料轮流过门。
combination.en: Design proposal: a logistics portal supports one link, requiring materials to take scheduled turns.

setup.zh: 高台无法直接爬上，附近有可放入口的地面与墙面。
setup.en: A high ledge is unreachable; nearby floor and wall surfaces accept portals.

action.zh: 你把一个入口放在落坑底部，另一个朝向高台，跳进落坑。
action.en: Place one portal beneath a drop and aim the other toward the ledge, then jump in.

result.zh: 下落速度从另一入口带出，把你送向高台。
result.en: Your falling speed carries through the other opening and launches you toward the ledge.

next.zh: 到达新位置后，重新布置入口处理下一处障碍。
next.en: From the new position, rearrange the portals for the next obstacle.

firstStep.zh: 先做二维成对传送、速度方向转换和一种可放置表面。
firstStep.en: Start with paired 2D portals, velocity-direction conversion, and one valid surface type.

pitfall.zh: 完整三维需要处理相机、穿门碰撞和递归画面；不要把它当作普通传送按钮。
pitfall.en: Full 3D adds camera, crossing collisions, and recursive rendering beyond a simple teleport button.

test.zh: 观察玩家能否利用入口朝向预测出口方向，并稳定复现同一次穿越。
test.en: Check whether players predict exit direction from orientation and repeat a traversal reliably.
